description: This is a Java source file implementing the BankingService interface. It provides methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and fund transfers within a banking application, utilizing Spring Framework annotations and repositories.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BankingService interface, providing core banking operations such as customer management, account handling, fund transfers, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers in the system, converting entity objects to domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database based on provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Fetches customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information based on customer number and provided details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account linked to a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between two accounts for a specific customer, recording transactions.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions associated with a specific account number.
